summary: Verified both reported bugs are fixed. Backend generate endpoint honors count param (count=3 -> 3 ocean-related ideas; count=5 -> 5 space-robotics ideas). Frontend UI end-to-end: clicking idea-count-5-button sends payload with count:5, backend returns 5 projects, and 5 project-card elements render. Zero template markers ('Insight Hub', 'Students need a focused', etc.) present in any output. mock_projects removed from server.py; AI failure paths raise HTTPException 503 with human-readable detail. Refine endpoint returns real AI content.

issues: Interests field lacks a data-testid attribute (only inferrable via label). Recommend adding data-testid='interests-input' for reliable test automation.
React hydration warning: <span> injected as child of <option> ('Cannot infer the option value of complex children'). Coming from dynamic instrumentation but noisy; acceptable but flag.

action_items: Optional: add data-testid='interests-input' (and other form fields) for improved test stability
Optional: pass explicit value prop on <option> to silence React hydration warning
critical_code_review_comments: server.py generate() top-up loop is limited to 2 retries; if LLM persistently under-delivers, response may contain fewer than count ideas silently sliced. Consider raising 503 if final count < requested.
Line 153 uses dead ternary `... if False else ...`; the True branch is unreachable. Simplify.
JWT_SECRET defaults to random per process if env missing; if backend restarts, all sessions invalidate. Should require env value.
seed_data_creation: None - used existing admin account and live AI generation
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bugs 1 & 2 fully verified. Generator form works. AI generation with count=5 takes ~40-60s in practice. Interests input has no data-testid - use label-based JS lookup or add testid. Test file at /app/backend/tests/test_generate_count.py is reusable for regression.
rca of the issue: Original bug: server.py contained mock_projects() returning a single hardcoded template idea whenever AI call failed/key missing, so users saw '1 static idea' regardless of count. Fix: removed mock entirely, added top-up loop that requests missing ideas excluding existing titles, slices to exact count, and raises 503 with human-readable detail on total failure. Verified via curl (count=3 ocean cleanup -> 3 unique ocean ideas) and via UI (count=5 space robotics -> 5 unique space/robotics ideas, payload has count:5).
